text:
emma: Heads-up — MapleFinancial sent a security questionnaire for our private (on-prem) package. Asks are: RBAC change history (180d), key provenance + HSM attestation, sample audit entries for unwrap/decrypt, vuln inventory for listed deps, and an IR playbook excerpt for key compromise. starting a thread to gather evidence.

ryan: link to questionnaire uploaded to drive: https://drive.internal/maple-q1. They explicitly say they only want representative artifacts, not full datasets.

tom: plan: produce a tight evidence bundle: 
- manifest.json (sha256 checksums)
- redacted-audit.log.gz (tenant ids -> <TENANT>)
- rbac-changes-180d.json (emails redacted)
- hsm-attestation-summary.pdf (CSR + attestation statement)
- cosign signature note for the bundle
We should avoid raw key material; provide signed key metadata and attestation only.

emma: legal: i'll ping @legal to confirm consent wording for key proofs and whether a DPA addendum is required. also confirm redaction expectations.

leah: vuln-triage update from sec-bot: CVE-2026-0456 (grpc) -> patched in 1.12.0. Hosted & Dedicated already patched. On-prem customers need scheduled patch (we recommend maintenance window within 30 days). Mitigations: disable insecure channel types + add ingress WAF rule.

sec-bot: vuln-triage: CVE-2026-0456 fixed in grpc v1.12.0. Advisory: low->medium depending on exposure. Patch plan and compensating controls recommended for on-prem installs.

ryan: for RBAC export please use the helper:
```
./tools/export_rbac.py --days 180 --redact emails --format jsonl --out rbac-maple-180d.jsonl
```
Ensure "role_change" events and approver ids are included.

tom: ran export, sample output looks like: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-04-01T08:12:23Z","event":"role_change","actor":"<REDACTED>","role":"inference-admin","change":"granted","ticket":"TKT-9123"}
```
I'll scrub PII per policy before adding to the bundle.

leah: IR playbook excerpt to include in the questionnaire answer: detection -> preserve -> contain -> rotate -> recover -> notify. More detail:
1) Detection: triage alert, capture timeline and affected artifacts.
2) Preserve evidence: take read-only snapshots, export audit-chain with hash, isolate affected hosts.
3) Contain/Rotate: revoke impacted keys, issue new key material via attested HSM flows, rotate derived tokens.
4) Recover: validate restoration from known-good snapshots, run replay checks against prompt testset.
5) Notify: internal SOC + customer notification within 1 business hour of confirmation. escalate to legal if exfiltration confirmed.

ryan: example commands for snapshot and audit export: 
```sh
# snapshot inference pod kv state
kubectl -n inference exec inference-0 -- tar czf /tmp/kvcache.tgz /var/lib/kv && kubectl cp inference/inference-0:/tmp/kvcache.tgz ./kvcache-maple.tgz
# export audit-chain for timeframe
./scripts/audit_export.sh --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-04-01 --filters "event:unwrap,event:decrypt" --redact tenant,email > redacted-audit-maple.gz
```

tom: uploaded initial bundle to internal share: /evidence/maple/2026-04-02. bundle is zipped + cosigned. manifest contains sha256 entries and a short README describing redaction.

emma: can someone cover the security review call? requested time: tomorrow 09:00am PT. need: tech lead + sec lead.

ryan: i can do the tech walkthrough.

leah: i can take sec lead.

tom: created INFSEC ticket INFSEC-4999 for the pending grpc advisory and scheduled the on-prem patch for 2026-04-09 (maintenance window). linking ticket in answer set.

emma: great. I'll draft the questionnaire answers, attach the evidence bundle, and include the mitigation timelines + ticket references. tagging this thread final prep. :white_check_mark:

tom: small follow-up — customer asked for a SIEM correlation example showing an unwrap -> admin-login sequence. i'll prepare a 10-line example log snippet with redacted identifiers.

leah: add that to the bundle under examples/siem-correlation.txt. keep it synthetic but realistic.

ryan: last note: ensure all artifacts have cosign sig and that manifest lists the signer CN. helps with provenance checks.

emma: noted. legal reply awaited; flagging this as ready for review once legal ack and artifacts are in the evidence share. close thread unless other asks.
